text: To set a 2019 meeting schedule for the Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Adopted the following 2019 meeting dates: January 29, 2019. February 26, 2019. March 26, 2019. April 30, 2019. May 28, 2019. June 25, 2019. July 9, 2019. September 24, 2019. October 29, 2019. November 26, 2019.
